Draadkar Grand Prix

By: Stenette Grosskopf | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
It's a one-of-a-kind event, a wire car Grand Prix in the heart of the Karoo

Unique Selling Point:
Once a year, the sleepy town of Philipstown in the Karoo is transformed into a hive of activity. Kids and the young at heart come from all over the district to take part in the Draadkar Grand Prix. it's a big event, a festival, aimed at showcasing the unique culture of the area. The draadkar grand Prix even has a place in the Guinness Book of Records. Hundreds of children will showcase their wire cars, expertly made, and will eventually take part in a mad dash through the streets of the town -- all in the name of local fame and prestige.

Summary:
The event was started by artist, Kay Fourie, who has a passion for the local culture and art. The project was started to inspire children of the area, to keep them creative and to give them a sense of hope.
All the locals gather to witness the spectacle and the competitors need to ensure that their wire cars are engineered to deliver maximum performance and that they are fit to outpace their opponents. This is a big event in the local Philipstown calendar, even the village garage displays a frieze of draadkarre created by local children to draw attention to this annual event. Artists from the Free State Art Collective will also be exhibiting their wire car work…
It promises to be a colourful, chaotic and interesting event showcasing draadkarre from “all walks of life”.

Extra Budget Items:
Travel to Philipstown and back
Accommodation for 4 people for 2 nights - 11 & 12 November 2022

Philipstown

Script:


DRAADKAR GRAND PRIX – Script


V/O
In the eastern Karoo, about 250kms south of Kimberley … lies Philipstown.
V/O
Established in 1863 by the Reformed Church, it has a colourful history, … but these days the town seems to have been forgotten by the 21st Century…


LINK
I bet many of you have never been to, or even heard of Philipstown…. And why would you? Nothing usually happens here. But today is different….
V/O
Today is the day the whole town has been looking forward to…
UPSOUND
Ag that’s so cute!
V/O
and not even the early morning thunderstorm can dampen the spirits.
UPSOUND
Waar’s jou gesig? Daar’s jou gesig!
Where’s your face? There’s your face!
V/O
These kids come from all over the district to take part in the annual Draadkar Grand Prix.
UPSOUND
Daarsy, jy’s genommer…
There you go, you are numbered.
V/O
There’s no entry fee and everyone under the age of 18 is welcome to participate…


V/O
…the only requirement is a wire car, and a willingness to have fun.
LINK
So, Philipstown is a buzz, the contestants are ready, their cars are revved and ready to roar. But I guess the true test will be - as beautiful as the car is, will it really be a winner?
V/O
But the day is not just about who is the fastest, expert craftsmanship is also rewarded…

And from the word go it is clear the judges will have their work cut out for them.
UPSOUND
Is dit ‘n Ford or ‘n Chev, of ‘n Dodge, Toyota? Wat is dit?

Daai’s ‘n bakkie!
‘N Polo…

Hierdie is ‘n Polo?

Is that a Ford or a Chev, or a Dodge, Toyota? What is it?
That’s a bakkie.
A Polo.
This one is a Polo?
V/O
And there’s no shortage of imagination when it comes to building the car of your dreams…
UPSOUND
Ek bou eers die seats en dan die sye… na die sye die voorkant…

I build the seats first and then the sides. After the sides, the front.

Mac: Het jy homself gebou met draad en alles? Hoe lank het dit jou gevat?
3 dae.
Mac: Drie dae… en wat het jy gebruik?
Net draad alleen en die blikke…

Did you build it yourself with wire and stuff?
Yes.
How long did it take you?
Three days.
Three days? And what did you use?
Just wire and the cans.
LINK
I remember building one of these when I was growing up. Not quite as elaborate as this one is. You know the fun thing about it is you have to go to the dumpsite and whatever to find your material, because this is like spray cans that you use as tyres and all of these small pieces. I mean look at that. Those are bottle caps. So, it’s a little bit of looking after the environment as well and recycling all in one…
V/O
To officially open the day… first a traditional quiet moment before the storm…
UPSOUND
Dankie dat ons ‘n geseende dag sal hê… In die naam van die Vader, die Seun en die heilige gees…. Amen

Thank you that we will have a blessed day. In the name of the Father, the Son and Holy Spirit. Amen.
UPSOUND
Drywers, is julle reg? Start julle enjins. Vroom

Drivers, are you ready?
Start your engines.
V/O
All eyes are on the handful of preschoolers, ready to hit the road…
MAC
Lets go! Draadkar Grand Prix!


Wegspring
V/O
In the blink of an eye it’s all over for these little ones … but there is still a lot more to come.
MAC
And here they come as you can see! Who is the fastest? Absolutely amazing
V/O
It’s a mad dash down a sidestreet to catch up with the drivers…
MAC
Jeez these guys are fast. Let’s see, let’s see.
MAC
This is around the church corner. As you can see the guys are coming at a blistering speed.
MAC
The one is just dragging his car behind!
V/O
The Draadkar Grand Prix is the brainchild of local artist, Kay Fourie.
Kay Fourie
Die Draadkar is die enigste Draadkar Grand Prix in die wereld.

The Draadkar is the only wire car grand prix in the world.
V/O
Kay was looking for ways to address some of the socio-economic problems in the local community.
Kay Fourie
Alkohol misbruik, dwelmmisbruik, gangsterism, you name it… maar dit was net oorweldigend. En toe het ons besluit, kom ons kies een groep mense, een ding, en een dag in ‘n jaar…

Alcohol abuse, drug abuse, gangsterism, you name it. But it was just overwhelming. And then we decided let’s choose one group of people, one thing, and one day in a year.
V/O
The event was first held in 2013.
Kay Fourie
Die eerste jaar was underwhelming… maar nogsteeds lekker.

The first year was underwhelming, but still fun.


MUSIC
V/O
Today it’s a celebration, filled with colour and culture… and a touch of chaos… bringing the entire community together…
Kay Fourie
Met die eerste Draadkar was daar letterlik een kind se pa wat belanggestel het en die kind bygestaan het. En dit is nogal deel van die probleem. Ouers het nie genoeg energie om die kinders te ondersteun nie want hulle het oorgenoeg probleme van hulle eie. Maar dit wemel van die ouers en pa’s maak die karre. Oompies help met die karre. Groot boeties help met die karre. Meisies begin deelneem. Ek is veral mal oor die meisies wat begin deelneem.

With the first Draadkar there was literally one child’s dad that was interested, and supported the child. And that is part of the problem; parents don’t have enough energy to support their children, because they have more than enough problems themselves. But now it swarms with parents, and dads make the cars. Uncles help with the cars. Big brothers help with the cars. Girls are starting to participate. I’m especially pleased about the girls starting to participate.
LINK
It’s midday and I’m already finished. The excitement in this town is… it’s almost contagious but I can’t keep up. I’m glad they only do this once a year because oh… I’m finished…
V/O
Perhaps what I need… is lunch!
Roosterkoek
MAC: hulle sê mos Sara se roosterkoek is die beste in Philipstown.
Ja hulle sê so.
MAC: Hoekom?
Ek weet nie hoekom nie, maar dit is so nou.
MAC: Maar brand jou hande nie?
Hulle brand! Jy moet net vinnig wees.
MAC: Wat sit jy in die roosterkoeke?
Net sout en suurdeeg en water. Dis al…
MAC: Maar as jy hom wil eet? Sit jy mince…
Botter, net soos jy hom wil hê, maar ek laaik hom net so droog.
MAC: Ek moet een proe.
Vat sommer die kleintjie, babatjie ene.
MAC: Is dit die enetjie?
Ja.
MAC: Ek gaan jou sê hoe werk daai hande van jou! Hmmm… dit is sag hierbinne.
Ja hy’s sag.
MAC: this is really nice.
Die Kapenaars maak hom met die vurk. Hy braai hom met die vurk. Hy steek hom vol gate.
MAC: Die Kapenaars? En julle?
Nee ons gebruik die hande.

They say Sara’s roosterkoek is the best in Philipstown.
Yes, they say so.
Why?
I don’t know, but it is.
But don’t you burn your hands?
They burn, but you must be quick.
What do you put in the roosterkoeke?
Just salt, yeast and water. That’s it.
But, when you want to eat it? Do you put mince…
Butter, just like you want it. But i like it dry as it is.
I must taste one.
Take this small, baby one.
Is it this one?
Yes.
I will tell you how your hands work.
Hmmm, it’s soft inside.
Yes, it’s soft.
Capetonians make it with a fork, they braai it with a fork. They poke them full of holes.
The Capetonians? And you?
No, we use our hands.
V/O
And there’s no shortage of Karoo treats…
Blikkiebroodjie
Ons noem dit ‘n Blikkiebroodjie. Hy kom al baie jare aan, Meneer. My Ma-hulle het hom gemaak. My Ouma-hulle het hom gemaak en ons maak hom ook nou.
Gee tog vir meneer.
Moet ons maar ‘n sousie bysit?
MAC: Het jy die sous gemaak? No, No No, marriage material!

We call it a “tin bread”. It’s been around for years, Sir. My mom made it. My grandma made it and now we make it.
Give him some.
Must we add a bit of sauce?
Did you make the sauce?


V/O
As the last drivers cross the finish line, some girls strut the stage to show off their recycle fashion… it’s laughter and smiles all round….
Kay Fourie
Ek is bietjie verslaaf aan die kinders se reaksie. Die opgewondenheid, die uitdrukkings op die gesiggies. Die involvement. Ek kan nie eintlik gewoond raak daaraan nie. Dit is wat dit absoluut die moeite werd maak.

I am a little bit addicted to the children’s reaction. The excitement, the expressions on their faces. The involvement. I can’t really get used to it. That is what makes it absolutely worth it.
V/O
The race champions and master builders walk away with trophies and sponsored prizes… but – as is customary in this community – these will be shared by all the kids… because today, here in Philipstown, everyone is a winner….


*****






PROMO 1 11”
It’s a race like no other, children from the eastern Karoo, dashing through the streets of Philipstown in the one-and-only Draadkar Grand Prix…




PROMO 2 21”
UPSOUND: (MAC) Ek sal hom net so vat… Hmmm
A taste of the Karoo as we join the annual Draadkar Grand Prix in Philipstown…

UPSOUND: Start julle enjins! Vroom!

It’s a mad dash for local fame and glory.




PROMO 3 21”
It’s a festival of colour and creativity … as a mob of eye-catching wire cars - and their drivers - dash through the streets of a small town in the Karoo.


The one-of-a-kind Philipstown Draadkar Grand Prix!
